how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.
Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).

Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.
important_instructions: Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted. Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face). Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof. The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit. Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam. Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall. A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature. Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.
